common_year_rule: Within each event x industry x lag_market, compare all six bins only on years complete for every bin and with nonempty same-year/state baseline support.
event_anchor_rule: Offset 0 is the first bound shared-calendar session on or after the fixed calendar anchor.
event_baseline: For each industry x year x lag_market, compare each event bin with the same-year same-lag_market industry rows outside the union of all pre-registered May and October windows.
event_industry_rule: B06, D44, D45, H61, H62, G56 are primary descriptive sectors; N78 and L72 are separately labeled MIXED_PROXY.
event_window_completeness: Each fixed bin requires every expected shared-calendar session to have a projection row and an eligible strict Top100. Otherwise preserve bounded support and a missing reason, and exclude the year from complete-window summaries.
goal: Describe daily A-share strict Top100 returns and industry distribution by calendar month and fixed ten-day segment, with all fixed May Day and National Day windows retained.
inference: No p-value, confidence interval, bootstrap, regression, causality, prediction, strategy, or economic total-return claim.
pass_signal: each eligible date has exactly 100 Top100 hits
daily industry expected hits sum to 100
complete month x ten-day grid is retained
event window support and reasons reconcile
year and full-period rows are derived from the same daily projection

pool_rule.industry_unknown: retain as UNKNOWN in the valid-pool denominator and Top100 distribution
pool_rule.source: B0 INPUT_BINDING.json exact bound QFQ panel fields and current retrospective industry classification
pool_rule.top100: return DESC, exact code ASC tie break, exactly 100 rows on dates with valid pool N >= 100
pool_rule.valid_row: finite positive close(T), finite positive close at exact immediately previous shared-calendar date, finite positive volume(T)

summary_weighting.daily_industry_mean_median_excess_sample: equal date across dates with N > 0
summary_weighting.excess: daily industry mean return minus same-day valid-pool mean return, then equal-date average
summary_weighting.median_summary_name: mean_daily_industry_median_equal_date; never presented as pooled median
summary_weighting.row_weighted_return_mean: sum of daily returns / sum of daily N
summary_weighting.top100_lift: sum daily hits / sum daily expected hits across eligible dates

summer_winter_rule: Inspect the complete month x ten-day grid for B06/D44 patterns; do not choose or tune post-hoc date windows.
zero_n_rule: When N=0, all industry return statistics including sums, mean, median, and sample std are null; expected Top100 hits is zero only on a Top100-eligible date.
